items.stem: A medication is prescribed at 500 mg. The supply is 125 mg in 10 mL. How many mL should the nurse administer? (Round to one decimal place if needed.)
Infuse 500 mL of IV fluid over 4 hours using an infusion pump. What rate in mL/hr should the nurse program? Round to the nearest whole number. (Round to one decimal place if needed.)
Infuse 500 mL over 120 minutes. The tubing drop factor is 20 gtt/mL. What flow rate in gtt/min should the nurse regulate? Round to the nearest whole number. (Round to one decimal place if needed.)
items.rationale: gtt/min = volume × drop factor ÷ minutes = 500 × 20 ÷ 120 = 83 gtt/min.
